title: README: export the service role key for local database tests

history.detail:
PASS: QA1 gate-1 audit, Sprint 40, audited commit c682803. The PASS is recorded at main HEAD 3a5af87. Everything between c682803 and HEAD touches only tree-hash-excluded paths: the sprint 43 file, the sprint 42 done-rename, registry.json and state/sprint-42.json (git diff --stat c682803 main). Verdict: PASS.

Sprint file: re-read fresh as amended (R3 amended; R5 amended for db reset; R6-R8 added; Human Prerequisites amended for Docker). Audited against the current file.

Handoff: read at c682803 with git show. Round 1 and Round 2 sections are present, and each quotes VERIFY PASS (lint, typecheck, test, build) exit=0. QA1's own npm run verify at HEAD: verify=0, 35 files, 444 tests.

R1: met.
- The recipe's three --override-name lines are character-identical to ci.yml lines 78-80.
- The filter is grep -E on the anchored names, so it keeps exactly the three variables.
- QA1 ran npx supabase start (no reset) and then npx supabase status -o env with the three overrides against the real local stack (CLI 2.114.0), followed by npx supabase stop. Output names: DB_URL, FUNCTIONS_URL, ... NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, ... SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. The README's filter kept exactly those three, all non-empty, with quotes stripped. All three would be set.
- The prose names all three variables and CI's step by its current name, "Export local stack URL/anon key/service role key".

R2: met. The policy-tests section now links to the Tier 2 heading; the anchor slug matches the heading "Tier 2: CI's rls-tests job, locally". grep test:rls finds only line 157 (prose) and line 234 (inside the one recipe, after the export).

R3: met.
- The Vitest/.env.local explanation is at lines 250-252.
- The demo-key and never-production sentences are in Tier 2 (252-255) and Local setup (92-95).
- Local setup's copy-into-.env.local instruction (88-91) is unchanged.
- No README text tells the reader to put production's service role key in .env.local; there is no vercel env pull or similar.

R4: met. The diff from edc08b7 to c682803 touches README.md, docs/handoffs/sprint-40.md and docs/handoffs/sprint-40/ (plus the excluded sprint file and state). No code, ci.yml or tests.

R5: met.
- tier2-run.log: preset_supabase_vars=0, and step1 to step5 all exit=0. test:rls ran 5 files, 43/43.
- recipe-as-run.sh is the README's Tier 2 block. QA1 re-extracted the block from README at c682803 and diffed it against that file: empty, exit 0. So Round 2's no-rerun claim holds; the evidence is from the recipe as now written.

R6: met. db reset follows start, and the data-loss sentence is at lines 243-245. supabase/migrations has 12 files at c682803, and the log has 12 "Applying migration" lines.

R7: met. Both named instances are corrected (line 96 and lines 316-318). grep applies finds no remaining claim that start alone applies every migration. The remaining hits are about db reset, db push on production and preview branches.

R8: met. The section names NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY as the only production values allowed and excludes the service role and OpenAI keys. It says writes fail without the service role key; QA1 confirmed that the only DB writes are insert.ts:42 (readings insert) and generate.ts:152 (set_reading_horoscope rpc), both on the admin writer, and every other call is an anon read rpc. "Delete it afterwards" is kept.

Out of scope respected: the "Running the built app locally" route list (Sprint 41's) is untouched.

Round 1 questions: both are settled by MC's amendment (R6 requires db reset; R8 rewrote the .env.local section). Nothing left for QA1 to rule on.

No new Human Prerequisites. The existing Docker one stands: docker info exits 0 on this machine as of this audit. QA1 did not run db reset, because it deletes local data; the reset is LiveQA's run to make, per the sprint file.
